question: Should interactive litellm-api-key onboarding prompt for a LiteLLM proxy base URL before model selection, or should remote LiteLLM proxy users be routed to the existing Custom Provider or future dynamic catalog path instead?
rationale: Both paths are plausible: a LiteLLM-specific URL prompt restores the reported workflow, but provider setup and live model discovery are compatibility-sensitive user-facing setup policy.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Restore the reported interactive workflow by asking for the LiteLLM proxy URL before model selection and keeping non-interactive custom-base-url behavior intact.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Document and enforce Custom Provider as the supported remote-proxy path, leaving litellm-api-key as the localhost/default proxy shortcut.

options.title: Defer To Dynamic Catalog
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74481 decides the broader live model discovery contract.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Restore the reported interactive workflow by asking for the LiteLLM proxy URL before model selection and keeping non-interactive custom-base-url behavior intact.
